notes.body:
Liver model of the metabolism of dextromethorphan
Dextromethorphan (DXM) is O-demethylated to dextrorphan (DXO) by CYP2D6, the pathway of the metabolizer phenotype, and by a CYP2D6-independent pathway (DXMCYPX, mainly CYP3A4 and CYP2C9), which carries the O-demethylation of poor metabolizers. Dextromethorphan and dextrorphan are N-demethylated by CYP3A4 to 3-methoxymorphinan and 3-hydroxymorphinan, which the model keeps as one lumped species (mm, free and conjugated), as the studies report them. Dextrorphan is glucuronidated (UGT2B15).
The rates are Michaelis-Menten kinetics; the hepatic concentrations are far below every Km, so the kinetics are linear and the data identify the intrinsic clearance Vmax/Km * Vli of a pathway: the Km are fixed at the values of human liver microsomes, the Vmax are the parameters of the fits.
The activity of CYP2D6 is the activity score of the diplotype (cyp2d6_activity) relative to two functional alleles (cyp2d6_activity_ref), times the factor f_cyp2d6 of an inhibitor; the activity of CYP3A4 is f_cyp3a4. The factors are set by the experiments from the observed interaction and are never fitted.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

The activity score of a diplotype of two fully functional alleles (*1/*1), at which the maximal rate DXMCYP2D6_Vmax is given: the rate of the O-demethylation by CYP2D6 scales linearly with cyp2d6_activity/cyp2d6_activity_ref.

The value of LI__DXMCYP2D6_Vmax is the result of the fit PK_20261020_094137__4239e, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

Of the order of the values of human liver microsomes, fixed: the hepatic concentrations are far below it, the kinetics are linear.
O-demethylation of dextromethorphan to dextrorphan (CYP2D6), the pathway of the metabolizer phenotype: it is most of the clearance of extensive metabolizers and absent in poor metabolizers.
CYP2D6-independent O-demethylation of dextromethorphan to dextrorphan (CYP3A4, CYP2C9), the low affinity site of the microsomes; it forms the dextrorphan of poor metabolizers.
N-demethylation of dextromethorphan to 3-methoxymorphinan (CYP3A4), the main CYP2D6-independent clearance of dextromethorphan.
N-demethylation of dextrorphan to 3-hydroxymorphinan (CYP3A4); 3-hydroxymorphinan is about 16 % of an oral dose in the urine of extensive metabolizers (Capon1996, Schadel1995).
Glucuronidation of dextrorphan (UGT2B15), the main route of the dextrorphan which is formed: about 96 % of the dextrorphan of the plasma is conjugated (Nagai1996).
